messages.content: What are the latest movie releases?

function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m afraid I don’t have real‑time access to current release schedules, so I can’t pull up a live list of the very latest movies. If you let me know a bit more—such as the country or region you’re interested in, or a specific time frame (e.g., “movies released in the last month” or “upcoming releases this week”)—I can give you a general idea of what’s been announced or suggest how you might find that information quickly.
message.reasoning: User asks: "What are the latest movie releases?" We need to respond with a list of recent movies. But we have no browsing capability. We can provide general info or ask for clarification. We could say we don't have real-time data. We can provide some known recent releases up to 2026? But we don't know. We can ask user for timeframe or location. Probably best to explain limitation.
